messages.body_plain:
Today' (Wed the 9th) meeting at 3:30 will cover basic R vector manipulation commands.  The Rmd file is already up on canvas.

This the second in what looks like it will be a 3 part series to teach you enough R to do the EDF 5400 lab 1 in R.
Some of the material I presented over the summer.

The zoom link is:
https://fsu.zoom.us/j/96939563935?pwd=aEVBamZ3eG9KcnZDYndlZEJWeEYzUT09

(The password we are using is `tidyverse`).

messages.body_plain:

We will explore possible visualizaitons.

    --Russell
